title: Pseudoephedrine seller self-certification and employee training
rule_summary: A regulated retail seller of scheduled listed chemical products must satisfy the CMEA self-certification and employee-training requirements before making covered retail sales; DEA's current self-certification system treats separate physical retail locations as separately certified locations.
exam_relevance: Tests store-level operational compliance before a sale rather than calculating a patient's purchase quantity.
exceptions: DEA pharmacy registrants may be treated differently for the self-certification fee, but the CMEA training and compliance duties still control covered sales.
common_confusions: Assuming a chain's certification at one store automatically authorizes all other physical locations.
verification_notes: Current official primary or official agency source checked on 2026-08-14.
